source: F-F13.2 controlled vocabulary, read 2026-11-16 from canada.ca IRCC pages and the IRB site (one office relocation from news, marked). kind is office, program or organization. canonical_name is the form a draft should use. ircc_aliases are other forms seen on the cited IRCC or IRB pages, common_variants are accepted shorthand not seen there. Aliases are lowercase and unique across rows after folding diacritics, and the canonical name is never repeated as an alias. status former means IRCC no longer uses the name and replaced_by names the current row. successor_note, when set, is what the flag names instead, where the source names more than one successor. letter_addressee says whether a submission may be addressed there: yes, on_request (only when that office asked), no, or n/a for a program. visa_codes ties a row to the ref.visa_types codes it belongs to. Public facts only, no client data.

ircc_vocabulary.note: IRCC issues a visitor visa or an eTA automatically with an initial study or work permit applied for before travel, so a study or work permit letter may name it. ircc_vocabulary.note: Issued automatically with an initial study or work permit applied for before travel, see the visitor visa row.
